notes.general_comments:
This paper covered the whole breadth of the syllabus and for those candidates who had covered the syllabus
thoroughly and had practised by answering previous papers, it gave the opportunity to achieve high marks.
General setting out was mostly satisfactory, but again it is necessary to request that candidates do not place
questions, or parts of questions, side by side on the page, as this can make it much more difficult to follow
their working.
